**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Consume a token before returning from waitForLimit**

`waitForLimit` currently checks `getStatus()` and returns as soon as `remaining > 0`, but it never calls `check()`/`checkLimit()` to decrement quota. Because the web/image/geo services only call `waitForLimit` before provider requests, quota is never consumed and throttling is effectively disabled under normal use. This should perform an actual limiter check (and only sleep when denied) so each request consumes capacity.

`download()` composes the output path from a user-controlled `filename` without validating absolute paths or `..` traversal segments, so callers can write outside `destination` (for example with `../` prefixes). In server usage (including the HTTP router), this allows arbitrary file overwrite outside the intended directory. Resolve and validate the final path is inside `destination_root` before writing.
